gameFacingRule: Game-facing means the engine package ships a live probe with the capability: a devtools probe name or a window.__jgengine* readout. A game adopts a capability by importing it (read from its source). A game that has a game-facing capability's domain but runs its own version records it as debt, with the open issue that tracks adopting the shared one, in its jgengine.json.
